context.situation: It's Thursday. Your friend calls to ask about the weekend. You want to meet, but you both have some plans already.
context.situation_ar: إنه يوم الخميس. صديقك يتصل ليسأل عن عطلة نهاية الأسبوع. تريدان أن تلتقيا، لكن لدى كل منكما بعض الخطط.
context.goal: Talk about plans and arrangements, make suggestions and agree on a time.
context.goal_ar: أن تتحدث عن الخطط والمواعيد، وتقترح، وتتفق على وقت.

script.t: Hey Leila. Are you doing anything on Saturday?
In the morning, yes. I'm working until one. Why?
There's a new Iraqi restaurant in town. How about lunch after work?
Sounds good! Oh wait — is Sami coming? He wanted to try it too.
I don't know. I'm going to call him tonight.
Great. And on Sunday I'm going to look at a flat. There are two nice ones, but I can't make a decision.
Do you want me to come with you?
Really? That would be great. I'm meeting the owner at eleven.
No problem. So: Saturday lunch at half one, Sunday at eleven.

gist.prompt: What do Karim and Leila decide?
options: To have lunch on Saturday and look at a flat on Sunday

detail.prompt: Why can't Leila meet on Saturday morning?
What is Leila's problem with the flats?
options: She likes both and can't choose.

notice.quote: Is Sami coming? — I don't know. I'm going to call him tonight.

question.prompt: Why does Karim say "I'm going to call him"?
question.prompt_ar: لماذا يقول كريم I'm going to call him؟
options: It's his plan — he decided before speaking.
He is calling him right now.

notice.explain: be going to + verb = a plan or intention you already have.
notice.explain_ar: be going to + فعل = خطة أو نية موجودة لديك مسبقًا.

notice.quote: I'm working until one. … I'm meeting the owner at eleven.

options: No — it's an arrangement for Saturday.

notice.explain: be + -ing can talk about the future when it's a fixed arrangement, usually with a time or a place: I'm meeting him at eleven.
notice.explain_ar: be + ing قد تعبر عن المستقبل عندما يكون موعدًا محددًا.

grammar.title: Plans: be going to · Arrangements: be + -ing
grammar.context: I'm going to call him tonight. — I'm meeting the owner at eleven.
grammar.pattern: be + going to + verb (plan)   ·   be + verb-ing + time (arrangement)
examples: I'm going to look for a new job.
Are you going to watch the match?
We're having dinner with my parents on Friday.
grammar.explain: Use going to for plans in your head. Use be + -ing for arrangements with other people, often with a time.
grammar.explain_ar: going to للخطط في ذهنك، و be + ing للمواعيد المرتبة مع الآخرين.
